itemText: Find out how a subject is chosen today when ingested knowledge becomes cards, and whether the existing cheap classifier already reports a confidence for it.

Collect the cards whose subject confidence is low and send them in one batch to a more capable but still cheap model, which suggests a subject from the existing subject list. Cards with high confidence skip this step so cost stays small.
Show the suggested subject on the card in Triage so the owner can accept or change it, and never auto-create a subject.
